```{r helpers, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Remove the trailing "_<batch>" suffix appended to sample IDs
strip_batch <- function(x) sub("(.*)_[^_]*$", "\\1", x)

# "a) X, b) Y, and c) Z" style list, used for narrative captions
letter_and_list <- function(x) {
  out <- paste0(letters[seq_along(x)], ") ", x)
  if (length(out) > 1) out[length(out)] <- paste("and", out[length(out)])
  out
}

# Color a PASSED / WARNING / FAILED status value for kable/LaTeX output
color_status <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "PASSED"  ~ cell_spec(x, background = "#006b54", color = "white"),
    x == "WARNING" ~ cell_spec(x, background = "#ffd858"),
    x == "FAILED"  ~ cell_spec(x, background = "#D2042D", color = "white"),
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# Wrap flagged cells in a red LaTeX colorbox.
# status_cols is a named vector: names are the columns in `status_df` that
# hold "FAILED"/"PASSED", values are the matching column to highlight in
# `value_df`. Matching is by row position, mirroring how the original
# per-row loops worked.
highlight_failed <- function(value_df, status_df, status_cols) {
  for (status_col in names(status_cols)) {
    val_col <- status_cols[[status_col]]
    rows <- which(status_df[[status_col]] == "FAILED")
    for (i in rows) {
      value_df[i, val_col] <- paste0(
        "\\colorbox{myred}{\\textcolor{white}{\\textbf{", value_df[i, val_col], "}}}"
      )
    }
  }
  value_df
}

# Standard PASSED/WARNING/FAILED legend used on the QC tables
pass_fail_legend <- c(
  "\\\\colorbox{mygreen}{\\\\textcolor{white}{PASSED}}", "  |  ",
  "\\\\colorbox{myyellow}{WARNING}", "  |  ",
  "\\\\colorbox{myred}{\\\\textcolor{white}{FAILED}}"
)

# Render a QC table: switches to a repeating longtable once it's too long
# for one page (>= longtable_threshold rows), otherwise scales to fit.
render_qc_table <- function(df, legend, italic_col = 3, longtable_threshold = 30) {
  long <- nrow(df) >= longtable_threshold
  df %>%
    kable(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = "c",
          row.names = FALSE, longtable = long) %>%
    kable_styling(
      latex_options = if (long) c("repeat_header", "scale_down") else c("scale_down", "hold_position"),
      font_size = if (long) 7 else NULL
    ) %>%
    row_spec(0, background = "#D4D4D4", bold = TRUE) %>%
    column_spec(italic_col, italic = TRUE) %>%
    footnote(general = legend, general_title = "Legend:", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE, escape = FALSE)
}
```

```{r load-data, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# --- rename species column to wgs_id and fill in genus-only IDs ---
wgs_df <- wgs_result_df %>%
  rename(wgs_id = species) %>%
  mutate(wgs_id = case_when(
    wgs_id == "Acinetobacter" ~ "Acinetobacter baumannii",
    wgs_id == "Escherichia"   ~ "Escherichia coli",
    TRUE ~ wgs_id
  ))

# --- load organism code reference file ---
org_df <- read_xlsx(here("data_files/", "whonet_codes_2024.xlsx"), "ORGANISM") %>%
  select(ORG_ARS, ORGANISM_name) %>%
  rename(wgs_id = ORGANISM_name, org_code = ORG_ARS)

# --- merge & clean organism code ---
wgs_df <- wgs_df %>%
  left_join(org_df, by = "wgs_id") %>%
  mutate(
    org_code_clean = case_when(
      wgs_id %in% c("Escherichia/Shigella", "Escherichia coli/Shigella") ~ "eco",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Salmonella enterica") ~ "sat",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Salmonella") ~ "sal",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus pseudopneumoniae") ~ "spn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus pyogenes") ~ "spy",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus oralis") ~ "sol",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Streptococcus") ~ "spn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Staphylococcus epidermidis") ~ "sep",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Staphylococcus") ~ "sau",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Shigella") ~ "shi",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Vibrio") ~ "vic",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Klebsiella") ~ "kpn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Raoultella planticola") ~ "kpn",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Pseudomonas") ~ "pae",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Acinetobacter") ~ "aba",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Burkholderia") ~ "pce",
      str_detect(wgs_id, "Serratia marcescens") ~ "sma",
      TRUE ~ org_code
    )
  )

```


```{r sample-sheet, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# --- Read samplesheet ---
wgs_samplesheet <- read_csv(here(paste0("data_files/", get_samplesheet, ".csv")))

# --- Get experiment name ---
WGS_exp_name <- unique(wgs_samplesheet$experiment_name)

# --- remove special characters in batch name ---
batch_name_clean <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", batch_code)

# --- Modify dataframe ---
wgs_samplesheet <- wgs_samplesheet %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = str_replace_all(toupper(sample_id), "-", "_"),
    sample_id = paste(sample_id, batch_name_clean, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  select(sample_id, description, index_plate_well)

```

```{r wgs-data, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# --- Subset wgs_df ---
wgs_id_df <- wgs_df %>% select(sample_id, wgs_id)

# --- paste batch number to arsrl result sample_id ---
arsrl_id_df <- arsrl_result_df %>%
  mutate(sample_id = paste(sample_id, batch_name_clean, sep = "_"),
    iso_num = row_number())

# --- merge arsrl result and samplesheet ---
arsrl_result_merge <- unique(arsrl_id_df) %>%
  left_join(unique(wgs_samplesheet), by = "sample_id")

# --- Merge WGS and ARSRL results, restore original WGS sample order ---
qc_listing_df <- unique(wgs_id_df) %>%
  left_join(unique(arsrl_result_merge), by = "sample_id")

qc_listing_df <- qc_listing_df[match(wgs_result_df$sample_id, qc_listing_df$sample_id), ]
qc_listing_df$wgs_id[is.na(qc_listing_df$wgs_id)] <- "Not Identified"

# --- Handle samples with no WGS results ---
wgs_no_result <- wgs_samplesheet[!wgs_samplesheet$sample_id %in% wgs_df$sample_id, ]


if (nrow(wgs_no_result) > 0) {
  qc_listing_df$description <- ifelse(
    is.na(qc_listing_df$description),
    wgs_id_df$description[match(
      paste0(wgs_no_result$sample_id, "_", batch_name_clean),
      wgs_id_df$sample_id
    )],
    qc_listing_df$description
  )
}

# --- Concordance check and assign isolate number---
qc_listing_df <- qc_listing_df %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = word(arsrl_org, 1),
    concordant = case_when(
      arsrl_org == "No Referred Data" ~ TRUE,
      wgs_id == "Not Identified"      ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ str_detect(wgs_id, Genus),
    ),
    arsrl_org = if_else(concordant, arsrl_org, paste0(arsrl_org, " (x)"))
  )

# Match concordance back to WGS df
wgs_df$concordant <- qc_listing_df$concordant[match(wgs_df$sample_id, qc_listing_df$sample_id)]

```


```{r sunburst-graph, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align='center'}
# --- Modify and Filter Bactscout dataframe ---
df_bactscout_mod <- df_bactscout %>%
  mutate(name = gsub("-", "_", name)) %>%
  filter(name %in% sample_name)  %>%
  mutate(species = str_remove(species, ";.*"))


final_result_df <- df_bactscout_mod %>%
  select(species, a_final_status) %>%
  mutate(species = if_else(is.na(species), "Unidentified", species))


sunburst_df <- final_result_df %>%
  count(species, a_final_status, name = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    label = a_final_status,
    parent = species
  )

# Add species as root nodes
species_df <- sunburst_df %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    label = species,
    parent = ""
  )

sunburst_data <- bind_rows(
  species_df %>% select(label, parent, value),
  sunburst_df %>% select(label, parent, value)
)


sunburst_data <- sunburst_data %>%
  mutate(
    bold_label = paste0("<b>", label, "</b>"),
    ids = ifelse(parent == "", label, paste(parent, "-", label)),
    color = case_when(
      label == "PASSED"  ~ "#006b54",
      label == "FAILED"  ~ "#D2042D",
      label == "WARNING" ~ "#ffd858",
      TRUE               ~ "#aec7e8" # Default for bacteria
    )
  )


# 3. Create the plot
fig <- plotly::plot_ly(
  data = sunburst_data,
  ids = ~ids,
  labels = ~bold_label,
  parents = ~parent,
  values = ~value,
  type = 'sunburst',
  branchvalues = 'total',
  marker = list(colors = ~color),
  insidetextfont = list(size = 15),
  outsidetextfont = list(size = 15),
  hovertemplate = "<b>%{label}</b><br>Value: %{value}<extra></extra>"
)

fig <- fig %>% plotly::layout(
  title = list(
    font = list(size = 10),
    y = 0.05,
    x = 0.5,
    xanchor = 'center',
    yanchor = 'bottom'
  ),
  margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, b = 0, t = 40) 
)


fig <- fig %>% plotly::layout(
  margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, b = 0, t = 40)
)

fig

```
